include_once comm_PerDefinition.txt

// -------------------------------------------------------
// 4.6 天通卫星（GEO轨道，通信中继）
// 仅承载卫星通信链路
// -------------------------------------------------------
platform_type TIAN_TONG_SAT WSF_PLATFORM
  radar_signature SAT_SIG

  mover WSF_SPACE_MOVER
    update_interval 1 sec
    oblate_earth true
    orbital_state
      epoch_date_time sep 15 2025 00:00:00
      semi_major_axis 42164 km
      eccentricity 0.0
      inclination 0 deg
      raan 120 deg
      argument_of_periapsis 0 deg
      mean_anomaly 0 deg
    end_orbital_state
  end_mover

  // 天通链路A
  comm sat_link WSF_RADIO_TRANSCEIVER
    on
    network_name COM_MESH_NET
    add medium UAV_MESH_MEDIUM
        channels 4
        mode "default"
          transfer_rate 16 kbits/sec
          //bit_error_probability 0.00001
      end_mode
    end_medium
    //channels 4
    //retransmit_attempts 3
    
    transmitter
      frequency 11.8 GHz
      bandwidth 54 MHz
      power 40 W
      polarization vertical
      antenna_pattern SAT_SPACE_BEAM_ANTENNA
      attenuation_model none
      end_attenuation_model
      //heck_terrain_masking off
    end_transmitter
    receiver
      frequency 14.2 GHz
      bandwidth 54 MHz
      polarization vertical
      antenna_pattern SAT_SPACE_BEAM_ANTENNA
      noise_figure 3 dB
      //heck_terrain_masking off
      detection_threshold -1000 dB
    end_receiver
    internal_link script_proc
  end_comm
  
  processor script_proc WSF_SCRIPT_PROCESSOR

    on_message
      type kForwardSituation
        script
          writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + " RECV " + MESSAGE.Type() + " from " + MESSAGE.Originator());
          string dest = MESSAGE.AuxDataString("destination");
          string nxts = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardSituation_" + dest + "_next_platform_name");
          if (nxts != "" && nxts != "interrupted") {
            string fw_sit_nexts_Change = nxts;
            string fw_sit_outs_Change  = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardSituation_" + dest + "_out_port_name");
            string fw_sit_ins_Change   = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardSituation_" + dest + "_next_in_port_name");
            string fw_sit_dsts_Change  = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardSituation_" + dest + "_dst_platform_name");

            if (fw_sit_dsts_Change == dest) {
              PLATFORM.Comm(fw_sit_outs_Change).SendMessage(MESSAGE, nxts, fw_sit_ins_Change);
              writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + "kForwardSituation Forward Out Port:[" + fw_sit_outs_Change + "] Destination:[" + dest + "] Next Plat:[" + nxts + "] Next Port:[" + fw_sit_ins_Change + "]");
            }
          }
        end_script

      type kForwardTarget
        script
          writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + " RECV " + MESSAGE.Type() + " from " + MESSAGE.Originator());
          string dest = MESSAGE.AuxDataString("destination");
          string nxts = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardTarget_" + dest + "_next_platform_name");

          if (nxts != "" && nxts != "interrupted") {
            string fw_tgt_nexts_Change = nxts;
            string fw_tgt_outs_Change  = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardTarget_" + dest + "_out_port_name");
            string fw_tgt_ins_Change   = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardTarget_" + dest + "_next_in_port_name");
            string fw_tgt_dsts_Change  = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardTarget_" + dest + "_dst_platform_name");
            //writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + "kForwardTarget Change Path Plats:" + nxts + " Ports: " + PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardTarget_" + dest + "_next_in_port_name"));

            if (fw_tgt_dsts_Change == dest) {
              PLATFORM.Comm(fw_tgt_outs_Change).SendMessage(MESSAGE, nxts, fw_tgt_ins_Change);
              writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + "kForwardTarget Forward Out Port:[" + fw_tgt_outs_Change + "] Destination:[" + dest + "] Next Plat:[" + nxts + "] Next Port:[" + fw_tgt_ins_Change + "]");
            }
          }
        end_script

      type kReturnReconVideo
        script
          writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + " RECV " + MESSAGE.Type() + " from " + MESSAGE.Originator());
          string dest = MESSAGE.AuxDataString("destination");
          string nxts = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconVideo_" + dest + "_next_platform_name");
          if (nxts != "" && nxts != "interrupted") {
            string rt_video_nexts_Change = nxts;
            string rt_video_outs_Change  = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconVideo_" + dest + "_out_port_name");
            string rt_video_ins_Change   = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconVideo_" + dest + "_next_in_port_name");
            string rt_video_dsts_Change  = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconVideo_" + dest + "_dst_platform_name");
            //writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + "kReturnReconVideo Change Path Plats:" + nxts + " Ports: " + PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconVideo_" + dest + "_next_in_port_name"));
            if (rt_video_dsts_Change == dest) {
              PLATFORM.Comm(rt_video_outs_Change).SendMessage(MESSAGE, nxts, rt_video_ins_Change);
              writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + "kReturnReconVideo Forward Out Port:[" + rt_video_outs_Change + "] Destination:[" + dest + "] Next Plat:[" + nxts + "] Next Port:[" + rt_video_ins_Change + "]");
            }
          }
        end_script

      type kReturnReconStatus
        script
         writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + " RECV " + MESSAGE.Type() + " from " + MESSAGE.Originator());
          string dest = MESSAGE.AuxDataString("destination");
          string nxts = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconStatus_" + dest + "_next_platform_name");
          if (nxts != "" && nxts != "interrupted") {
            string rt_status_nexts_Change = nxts;
            string rt_status_outs_Change  = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconStatus_" + dest + "_out_port_name");
            string rt_status_ins_Change   = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconStatus_" + dest + "_next_in_port_name");
            string rt_status_dsts_Change  = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconStatus_" + dest + "_dst_platform_name");
            //writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + "kReturnReconStatus Change Path Plats:" + nxts + " Ports: " + PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconStatus_" + dest + "_next_in_port_name"));
            if (rt_status_dsts_Change == dest) {
              PLATFORM.Comm(rt_status_outs_Change).SendMessage(MESSAGE, nxts, rt_status_ins_Change);
              writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + "kReturnReconStatus Forward Out Port:[" + rt_status_outs_Change + "] Destination:[" + dest + "] Next Plat:[" + nxts + "] Next Port:[" + rt_status_ins_Change + "]");
            }
          }
        end_script
      default
        script
          writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + " RECV " + MESSAGE.Type() + " from " + MESSAGE.Originator());
        end_script

    end_on_message

  end_processor
end_platform_type

// -------------------------------------------------------
// 4.7 神通卫星（LEO轨道，通信中继）
// 仅承载卫星通信链路
// -------------------------------------------------------
platform_type SHEN_TONG_SAT WSF_PLATFORM
  radar_signature SAT_SIG

  mover WSF_SPACE_MOVER
    update_interval 1 sec
    oblate_earth true
    orbital_state
      epoch_date_time sep 15 2025 00:00:00
      semi_major_axis 42164 km
      eccentricity 0.0
      inclination 0 deg
      raan 120 deg
      argument_of_periapsis 0 deg
      mean_anomaly 0 deg
    end_orbital_state
  end_mover

  comm sat_link WSF_RADIO_TRANSCEIVER
    on
    network_name COM_MESH_NET
    add medium UAV_MESH_MEDIUM
      channels 4
      mode "default"
        transfer_rate 16 mbits/sec
        //bit_error_probability 0.00001
      end_mode
    end_medium

    transmitter
      frequency 11.8 GHz
      bandwidth 54 MHz
      power 40 W
      polarization vertical
      antenna_pattern SAT_SPACE_BEAM_ANTENNA
      attenuation_model none
      end_attenuation_model
      //heck_terrain_masking off
    end_transmitter
    receiver
      frequency 14.2 GHz
      bandwidth 54 MHz
      polarization vertical
      antenna_pattern SAT_SPACE_BEAM_ANTENNA
      noise_figure 3 dB
      //heck_terrain_masking off
      detection_threshold -1000 dB
    end_receiver
    internal_link script_proc
  end_comm

  processor script_proc WSF_SCRIPT_PROCESSOR
        on_message
      type kForwardSituation
        script
          writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + " RECV " + MESSAGE.Type() + " from " + MESSAGE.Originator());

          string nxts = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardSituation_" + dest + "_next_platform_name");

            string fw_sit_nexts_Change = nxts;
            string fw_sit_outs_Change  = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardSituation_" + dest + "_out_port_name");
            string fw_sit_ins_Change   = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardSituation_" + dest + "_next_in_port_name");
            string fw_sit_dsts_Change  = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardSituation_" + dest + "_dst_platform_name");

            if (fw_sit_dsts_Change == dest) {
              PLATFORM.Comm(fw_sit_outs_Change).SendMessage(MESSAGE, nxts, fw_sit_ins_Change);
              writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + "kForwardSituation Forward Out Port:[" + fw_sit_outs_Change + "] Destination:[" + dest + "] Next Plat:[" + nxts + "] Next Port:[" + fw_sit_ins_Change + "]");
            }
          }
        end_script

      type kForwardTarget
        script
          writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + " RECV " + MESSAGE.Type() + " from " + MESSAGE.Originator());
          string dest = MESSAGE.AuxDataString("destination");
          string nxts = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardTarget_" + dest + "_next_platform_name");

          if (nxts != "" && nxts != "interrupted") {
            string fw_tgt_nexts_Change = nxts;
            string fw_tgt_outs_Change  = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardTarget_" + dest + "_out_port_name");
            string fw_tgt_ins_Change   = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardTarget_" + dest + "_next_in_port_name");
            string fw_tgt_dsts_Change  = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardTarget_" + dest + "_dst_platform_name");
            //writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + "kForwardTarget Change Path Plats:" + nxts + " Ports: " + PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardTarget_" + dest + "_next_in_port_name"));

            if (fw_tgt_dsts_Change == dest) {
              PLATFORM.Comm(fw_tgt_outs_Change).SendMessage(MESSAGE, nxts, fw_tgt_ins_Change);
              writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + "kForwardTarget Forward Out Port:[" + fw_tgt_outs_Change + "] Destination:[" + dest + "] Next Plat:[" + nxts + "] Next Port:[" + fw_tgt_ins_Change + "]");
            }
          }
        end_script

      type kReturnReconVideo
        script
          writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + " RECV " + MESSAGE.Type() + " from " + MESSAGE.Originator());
          string dest = MESSAGE.AuxDataString("destination");
          string nxts = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconVideo_" + dest + "_next_platform_name");
          if (nxts != "" && nxts != "interrupted") {
            string rt_video_nexts_Change = nxts;
            string rt_video_outs_Change  = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconVideo_" + dest + "_out_port_name");
            string rt_video_ins_Change   = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconVideo_" + dest + "_next_in_port_name");
            string rt_video_dsts_Change  = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconVideo_" + dest + "_dst_platform_name");
            //writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + "kReturnReconVideo Change Path Plats:" + nxts + " Ports: " + PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconVideo_" + dest + "_next_in_port_name"));
            if (rt_video_dsts_Change == dest) {
              PLATFORM.Comm(rt_video_outs_Change).SendMessage(MESSAGE, nxts, rt_video_ins_Change);
              writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + "kReturnReconVideo Forward Out Port:[" + rt_video_outs_Change + "] Destination:[" + dest + "] Next Plat:[" + nxts + "] Next Port:[" + rt_video_ins_Change + "]");
            }
          }
        end_script

      type kReturnReconStatus
        script
         writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + " RECV " + MESSAGE.Type() + " from " + MESSAGE.Originator());
          string dest = MESSAGE.AuxDataString("destination");
          string nxts = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconStatus_" + dest + "_next_platform_name");
          if (nxts != "" && nxts != "interrupted") {
            string rt_status_nexts_Change = nxts;
            string rt_status_outs_Change  = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconStatus_" + dest + "_out_port_name");
            string rt_status_ins_Change   = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconStatus_" + dest + "_next_in_port_name");
            string rt_status_dsts_Change  = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconStatus_" + dest + "_dst_platform_name");
            //writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + "kReturnReconStatus Change Path Plats:" + nxts + " Ports: " + PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconStatus_" + dest + "_next_in_port_name"));

              PLATFORM.Comm(rt_status_outs_Change).SendMessage(MESSAGE, nxts, rt_status_ins_Change);
              writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + "kReturnReconStatus Forward Out Port:[" + rt_status_outs_Change + "] Destination:[" + dest + "] Next Plat:[" + nxts + "] Next Port:[" + rt_status_ins_Change + "]");
            }
          }
        end_script
      default
        script
          writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + " RECV " + MESSAGE.Type() + " from " + MESSAGE.Originator());
        end_script

    end_on_message
  end_processor

end_platform_type
